title: P-auth4: preauthorization never grants role index 1
description: mimid-1wgh.3.49 says the preauthorized target must not be 0/1. Applied literally, index 1 is excluded regardless of its name, so a renamed role 1 (legal ordinary role per mimid-1wgh.3.42) cannot be joined via preauthorization. Chosen: literal, the stricter reading.
